items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: To me there was nobody like Bud Powell. He was so exciting.

ctx.x: Who was your favorite bebop artist on keyboard?
Bud Powell. By far, yeah. He was outstanding. To me there was nobody like Bud Powell. He was so exciting. Yeah.
You know you said that for a time you tried to play like Teddy Wilson. And another great artist, Clark Terry, talked about first imitation, then integration, then innovation.
